name: 🎮NEED MORE PLAYTIME🎮
desc:
It's an awesome day after school because your favorite game just got a new update! You can't wait to play. But, there's a rule at home.. mom only lets you play after you have done the chores.. If you show mom how good you are at doing things around the house, maybe she'll let you play more!?

Don't forget to like the game! 👍

Credits to MaxXD_22 for making "NEED MORE HEAT." This game were heavily inspired by it. Go play his game if you haven't yet!

Tags: Endings, Need More, Playtime, Strict
